hunks.sol: Hyeoncheon did not have to wait long for an answer.

hunks.baseline: Half an hour later, after confirming the true form of the Killing Ghost, whose remains had been carried over by Wudang Disciples, Hyeoncheon remained silent for a long while before finally speaking.
hunks.sol: Half an hour later, Wudang Disciples brought the body before him. He saw what the Killing Ghost truly was and remained silent for a long time before speaking.

hunks.baseline: Reflected in the old Daoist’s clear eyes was something else entirely—neither beast nor human.
hunks.sol: Reflected in the old Daoist’s clear eyes was something neither beast nor human.
